source.author_body: Hey Indie Hackers! A lot of solo founders ask how it's actually possible to build and ship a complex B2B product completely alone without a team or VC funding. Meet Flow Era – a real-time sales brain designed for digital creators that detects visitor hesitation and triggers the right conversation before they bounce (not a CRM, not a generic chat). I built the entire thing end-to-end as a solo founder, moving from Lovable for the fast MVP, straight into VS Code & GitHub for full code control, working hand-in-hand with Claude as my senior dev. Where I am right now: The product is fully built, market-ready, and polished. Right now, I'm at the most exciting (and terrifying) milestone: getting my very first paying subscribers on board. No massive marketing team, no funding—just a lethal AI stack, a real problem, and relentless execution. For those of you who went through this exact phase: How did you land your very first paying customers when launching solo? Any advice, war stories, or tips would mean the world. Let's chat in the comments!

metadata.headline: I built a real-time sales brain for creators as a solo founder. Now I need my first paying user.

source.decision: Discussion/seller/product research only; no paid buyer or complete competition/contact evidence
